hero.subtitle: CPUs, networks and storage have monitoring and audit trails. GPUs, where the most sensitive AI compute happens, are a black box. We close that visibility gap.

challenge.title: The gap
challenge.body: GPU infrastructure runs the most sensitive AI workloads with the least visibility.
points: Invisible crashes: GPU failures with no root cause
Opaque utilization: figures with no view of what drives them
Unverified isolation: tenant separation and VRAM hygiene assumed, not proven
Undetected attacks at the GPU layer

opportunity.title: One agent. One plane. One platform.
opportunity.body: One agent on any accelerator, one view down to the individual GPU and tenant, and one platform that both stops runtime threats and produces compliance evidence. It is a natural companion to our Sovereign AI Platform.

capabilities.title: One agent, deploys anywhere
capabilities.body: A single runtime on any GPU, cloud or region, across GPU vendors and emerging accelerators.

capabilities.title: One plane, sees inside every GPU
capabilities.body: Unified telemetry across workload, model, container, GPU and tenant.

capabilities.title: Runtime threat detection and response
capabilities.body: Runtime detection and response, with policy enforcement and SOC alerts.

capabilities.title: Continuous audit evidence
capabilities.body: One platform that stops threats and proves compliance, with audit evidence produced continuously.

applications.title: With our Sovereign AI Platform
applications.body: Proves tenant isolation and produces audit evidence on every GPU we operate.

applications.title: Multi-tenant GPU clouds
applications.body: Telemetry down to GPU and tenant, so tenant separation is proven rather than assumed.

applications.title: GPU failures and utilization
applications.body: A view of what is running on each GPU, and what drives its utilization.

applications.title: Security operations
applications.body: Runtime alerts and policy enforcement delivered to the SOC.

outcomes.label: Critical attack classes that complete with zero alerts
Agent on any GPU, cloud or region

vision2030.body: On our Sovereign AI stack, security and governance are aligned with NCA ECC / CCC, PDPL and SDAIA AI Ethics. This platform supplies the GPU runtime security and the continuous audit evidence.

deployment.note: A single runtime agent that deploys on any GPU, cloud or region, including dedicated AI factories and operator GPU clouds in the Kingdom.

extras.title: Entry point: the GPU Compute Assessment
items: We show what is running, and what should not be
The assessment effectively serves as the POC
